title: Comfort Club Tier-Upgrade Timing and the Replacement System Installations Member Install Credit
content:
# Tier-age multiplier on the member install credit

## Rule

The tier-age factor of the member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract looks at the visit grants posted to the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement for a tier upgrade:

- a tier-upgrade grant in the 3 months before the date of handling multiplies the credit by 0.5;
- a tier-upgrade grant in the 6 months before the date of handling but none in the last 3 months multiplies it by 0.75;
- with no tier-upgrade grant in the last 6 months the credit keeps 1.0.

Tier-upgrade grants are the visit grant entries the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records post to an agreement when it moves to a higher tier.

## Decision table

| Tier-upgrade grant in the last 3 months | Tier-upgrade grant in the last 6 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| No | Yes (between 3 and 6 months ago) | 0.75 |
| No | No | 1.0 |

## Cases (hypothetical agreements)

- Upgraded to a higher tier 2 months before the date of handling: 0.5.
- Upgraded 4 months before the date of handling: 0.75.
- Upgraded 8 months before the date of handling: 1.0.
- Upgraded 5 months ago and again 1 month ago: the grant 1 month ago falls in the last 3 months — 0.5.
